evidence.quote: So far I have wasted 10,045 which included the re-investing amount money as well. The money is 841 dollars.
I have almost 10,000 in my account So after 80 days I will get $1000 out of 10000.

textual.context: First-person account of the speaker's transactions and expected return; the source does not establish whether the statement is promotional, hypothetical or otherwise qualified.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated monetary return is connected to an account balance and reinvestment activity, creating a reward-or-return claim with a specified timeframe for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify the platform, account, transaction amounts, return, timeframe or outcome. ASR may contain transcription errors, and no payment interface or other visual evidence was supplied.

textual.observation: The description invites viewers to join a Bitconnect destination through a referral URL, while the accompanying ASR discusses earning money through reinvestment and presents a platform as the best.

evidence.quote: Very much excited to show that Nimbocoin is the best platform.
and only the money re-invested in a daily part is earned.

textual.context: The description is an apparent invitation and referral-link promotion. The ASR contains an enthusiastic first-person endorsement, but the records do not clarify whether the Bitconnect and Nimbocoin references concern the same platform or whether the speaker receives a referral benefit.
textual.potential_relevance: An audience-directed join action and referral destination are associated in the supplied records with an endorsement and an earning-through-reinvestment claim, requiring later assessment of the relationship and context.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish destination ownership, affiliation, referral compensation, platform identity, transaction requirements, or any resulting benefit or loss. The ASR contains possible recognition errors.

visual.observation: A Bitconnect account interface shows a section labeled "LEND BITCONNECT / REINVEST" with buttons for lending and reinvesting. The visible text states that users will receive daily profit based on their investment option and, after the investment term is completed, will receive their capital back.
visual.context: This appears within a Bitconnect-branded logged-in account interface; the sampled frames do not establish whether the presenter is promoting, warning about, or demonstrating the feature.
visual.potential_relevance: A stated financial return and capital-return outcome is directly linked to the requested lending or reinvestment action and to completion of an investment term.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether the stated profits or capital return occurred, what the investment terms were, or whether any funds were transferred.

visual.observation: The account dashboard visibly reports "Total investment $10,220.00," "Active investment $10,220.00," "Total capital released $0.00," and "Total earned $814.13."
visual.context: These figures are displayed as account-summary fields in a logged-in Bitconnect interface.
visual.potential_relevance: The displayed earned amount and unreleased-capital amount are presented alongside an active investment balance, connecting a claimed account return to the platform's investment activity.
visual.limitations: The sampled screen cannot verify the accuracy of the figures, whether the balance was withdrawable, or whether the account belonged to the person recording the video.

visual.observation: The transaction history visibly includes entries labeled "Received from lending wallet," "Paid for lend ID," "Buy BCC," and "Re-investment," with cryptocurrency amounts and completed-status indicators.
visual.context: The entries are shown in a Bitconnect account's transaction and dashboard views; the frames do not show the surrounding explanation or the actual movement of funds outside the interface.
visual.potential_relevance: The interface concretely associates lending, reinvestment, and cryptocurrency purchases with recorded asset transfers and payment entries.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish that the transactions were completed on a blockchain, that funds were received by any external party, or that the displayed records reflect real-world settlement.

visual.observation: A Bitconnect account page visibly says "Earn by referring new members" and shows a referral link field with a "Copy" button.
visual.context: The offer appears in a section labeled "Referral" within the logged-in account interface; whether the narrator is actively encouraging recruitment is unclear from the sampled frames.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised earning opportunity is directly linked to recruiting or referring new members and using the displayed referral link.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show the reward amount, eligibility conditions, whether anyone was recruited, or whether any referral payment was made.

visual_context_notes.observation: The homepage is visibly Bitconnect-branded and displays the tagline "THE CRYPTOCURRENCY REVOLUTION" alongside navigation for exchange, lending, and other account features.
The sampled footage is a screen recording of the website with a webcam view of the presenter overlaid in the lower-right corner.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker invites viewers to join Bitconnect through a referral URL while presenting an expected $1,000 return from a $10,000 investment after 80 days and linking earnings to reinvestment. The account screens also associate participation with lending or reinvestment for stated daily profit and present new-member referrals as another earning mechanism. Although the dashboard shows investment and earnings figures, it does not independently verify that the balances, transactions, promised returns, or capital recovery were genuine or withdrawable.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content links participation in Bitconnect lending and reinvestment to daily profit, return of capital after an investment term, and reported account earnings. This supports an investment or lending-return mechanism. The supplied evidence does not independently verify that the displayed balances or returns were real or withdrawable.
